name: RACK_OCCUPANCY_V1
steps: load Rack and derive Site through Room
require Network Element authoritative Site equals Rack-derived Site
require u_start>=1 and u_span>=1 and u_start+u_span-1<=rack.height_u
inside current UnitOfWork query current placements on same rack where existing.u_start < candidate_end AND existing.u_start+existing.u_span > candidate_start excluding the target Network Element
any result returns RACK_U_OCCUPIED with bounded blocker summary
otherwise placement is valid and event/current projection may commit
rules: containment relation is ignored for occupancy and is not mutated
unracked placement stores rack/u fields null
Rack height reduction runs the same guard against every current placement and fails if any end exceeds new height
row/column labels do not affect U occupancy or identity
complexity: indexed one-Rack overlap search; no whole-Infrastructure pairwise scan
